Form

Checkbox

Tri-state checkbox (checked / unchecked / indeterminate) built on @rn-primitives/checkbox.

Import

tsx
import { Checkbox } from "@mvp-ui-rn/ui"

Usage

tsx
import { Checkbox } from "@mvp-ui-rn/ui"

<Checkbox
  checked={agreed}
  onCheckedChange={setAgreed}
  label="I agree to the terms of service"
/>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
checkedrequired
boolean | "indeterminate"—

Controlled checked state.

onCheckedChangerequired
(checked: boolean) => void—

Callback fired when the state changes.

label
string—

Optional text label rendered to the right of the box.

size
"sm" | "md""md"

Box size — md=24pt, sm=20pt.

isDisabled
booleanfalse

Disables the checkbox and applies reduced opacity.

React Native Notes

  • hitSlop extends the tappable area to meet the 44pt HIG touch target floor.
  • Tapping an indeterminate checkbox transitions to checked, mirroring native browser behavior.
  • Pair with FormField for label + hint + error layout.
